style: Swiss minimal, warm paper, one orange accent; restraint, generous negative space, one signature ease (expo.out), no decoration

scenes.motion: a single orange dot appears at optical center (expo.out), then stretches into a thin horizontal line as wide as the second line of type (power3.inOut)
the line acts as a mask edge: 'Menos,' rises out of it, 'pero mejor' descends out of it (expo.out, 0.12s stagger); then breathe
the line retracts into its right end and becomes a dot; the two lines close the gap; the dot drops into place as the period of the sentence and holds

brief: One orange dot is the whole story: it appears, becomes a horizon that reveals 'Menos, pero mejor', then pulls itself back into a single point and lands as the period. Form and message agree: fewer elements, better executed. Hook within the first second (dot + stretch), final lockup held ~1.15s.
